summary: Phase 1 testing of 'Oferte de preț' and 'Contracte'. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass. Covered: numbering 249→250, duplicate, no number reuse after delete, numbering PUT rules; totals (equipment/services split, % and amount discount, VAT applied once, prices_include_vat extraction, EUR→RON); offer PDF (filename Oferta_de_pret_249.pdf, 'OFERTĂ DE PREȚ NR. 249', NR REG; 401 without token); status gate; payment preview; avans > net → 400; tranches over total → 400; contracts 93/94/95 with integral, avans and tranches; 409 on repeat, regenerate keeps the number and stores a revision; edit after contract → 409, then version+1 with contract unchanged and offer_changed/contract_outdated flags; versions list; contract PDF (7–8 pages, Anexa 1 + Anexa 2); contract status; template pending/reject/approve, with the next contract using the approved version; isolation (404 for another tenant); feature gate (PRO plan → 402). Frontend flows all work: offers list, new offer, PF/PJ switch, items with category change, discount, save updates totals, preview dialog, status → Acceptată, contract dialog (integral/avans previews, advance error disables Generate, tranches) → contract 96, edit-confirm banner, duplicate, Contracts page status select and PDF link, template editor save/approve/reject, numbering panel error toast. Cleanup done: admin tenant is back to offer_next=249, contract_next=93, template v0; all TEST offers, contracts, versions, counters and templates deleted, plus the sub_ test user.

minor.issue: Read-then-write counter is not atomic. Two concurrent creates can pick the same number; the unique index then makes the second insert fail with an unhandled 500 instead of retrying. Use find_one_and_update with $inc, or retry on DuplicateKeyError.
If 'payment' is not a dict (e.g. a string), c['payment'].get raises a 500 instead of a 400.

Every save of a draft bumps the version and writes an offer_versions snapshot. Each editor action (Save, Preview, status change) saves first, so versions grow quickly (v4 after a few UI clicks). Consider versioning only after the offer is Trimisă/Acceptată or after a contract exists.
Approving a pending version identical to the active one still creates a new approved version. No diff check; harmless.

ui_bugs.issue: Input typed right after the editor opens (under about 1s) is silently lost. Under React StrictMode the load() effect runs twice, and the second GET response overwrites local state. Reproduced: offer beneficiary name typed right after 'Ofertă nouă' was wiped, and a template article edit was wiped, so the saved pending version had the original text. It works when typing after the load settles. This is dev-only, but guard it anyway (ignore stale responses, or only set state when the id matches).

There is no delete button in the UI, even though the backend allows deleting Ciornă offers. 'Ofertă nouă' creates an offer immediately, so every accidental click burns a number and leaves an empty draft in the list for good.

issues: The DialogContent grid splits the 90vh height between the header row and the iframe row, leaving about 300px of empty space above the PDF iframe. Use flex flex-col with the iframe as flex-1.
Escape does not close the dialog while focus is inside the PDF iframe (only the X button works).
The final signature block after art. XII can spill alone onto its own page (page 6 has only signatures). Wrap the last paragraph and the signature block in KeepTogether.
The left (Ofertant) and right (Beneficiar) signature lines sit at different heights because the left side has an extra line (rep).
Uses the browser's native date input (offer-date, contract-date, contract-due_date) instead of the shadcn calendar.
The offer versions history (GET /offers/{id}/versions) is not shown anywhere in the UI.

action_items: Add a delete button for Ciornă offers without a contract (or create the offer only on first save) so accidental 'Ofertă nouă' clicks don't burn numbers.
Make next_number atomic or retry on DuplicateKeyError.
Return 400 for a malformed payment object in contract create/preview.
Fix the preview dialog layout (iframe should fill the height) and keep the contract signature block together with art. XII.
Optionally guard OfferEditor/Template load() against stale responses, and show the versions history in the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: offers_routes.py: next_number/peek duplicate logic; the counter is not atomic (see minor).
contracts_list does N+1 offer lookups, and its offers.find_one has no owner filter (safe because offer_id comes from the owner's contract, but add the filter for consistency).
Deleting an offer does not delete its offer_versions entries.

pay_calc tranches: percent tranches are computed on the net amount and the remainder is added automatically. Correct, but advance_value is silently ignored when tranches exist; the UI does label this.
The offer_pdf 'Valoare' column shows qty*unit_price, which is gross when prices_include_vat=true, while the totals are net. A note is printed under the table; acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; dev-only early-typing race and missing delete button)

seed_data_creation: None left behind. All TEST offers and contracts, offer_versions, counters offer:/contract:, contract_templates and the sub_*@example.com user were deleted. Verified: GET /offers/numbering → {offer_next:249, contract_next:93}, template active v0, 0 offers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_iter22_offers_contracts.py against a clean admin tenant (it asserts 249/93 at the start). Afterwards clean db.offers/contracts/offer_versions/counters(id ^offer:|^contract:)/contract_templates and the sub_ users it registers. In Playwright, wait about 2s after the editor or template mounts before typing (StrictMode double-fetch). PDFs in iframes don't render in headless mode; verify them with page.request.get instead.
